verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own README says its LLM-driven extraction supports open-source as well as proprietary LLMs, and the docs say no API keys are forced. That implies non-cloud models can serve as the extraction backend, but it is a single high-level claim with no documented setup for a local or self-hosted endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit docs on configuring a local or self-hosted model endpoint (e.g., a base URL or provider setting), named supported local runtimes, and hands-on or independent confirmation that local-model extraction works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model

citations.quote: LLM-Driven Extraction: Supports all LLMs (open-source and proprietary) for structured data extraction.
No forced API keys, no paywalls—everyone can access their data.
Parse repeated patterns with CSS, XPath, or LLM-based extraction.
